duty_station_not_in_fjc_export.description: Judges' duty stations (the courthouse/city where each judge sits) are not a field in the FJC Biographical Directory export; district_judges.duty_station is empty.
duty_station_not_in_fjc_export.reason: duty station not in FJC export (checked every column of judges.csv, federal-judicial-service.csv and demographics.csv)

judge_counts_before_1950.description: Sep 30 judge counts are produced from 1950 on. Earlier years would need each court's pre-1950 splits, mergers and abolitions curated (e.g. Virginia 1864-1871, Louisiana 1866-1881, California 1866-1886); district_judges.csv still lists every service record back to 1789 for timelines.
judge_counts_before_1950.reason: scope: court-organization history before 1950 not curated

judge_counts_before_first_article3_judge.description: D. Alaska: no Sep 30 judge counts for 1950-1959. The court in its current form had no Article III judge in the FJC directory before 1960-02-19 (court created, reorganized, or converted to Article III status later); counts are omitted rather than shown as zero.
judge_counts_before_first_article3_judge.reason: court in its current form did not yet have Article III judges
